validation_type: Deterministic software/control-plane integration; no live LLM or learned-model inference

earlier_migration_suite.failure: Test attempted to mutate frozen EvaluationEvidence. Corrected with model_copy; corrected test is included in final passing suite.

verified_behaviors: Numeric fixture pass remains sample evidence; promotion rejected.
Explicit local_trial consent and reason required even when numeric target passes.
Batch and live local trial preserve approval scope in evidence and skip external delivery.
Each compared candidate uses the same frozen validation protocol.
Metadata/policy edits revoke approvals and invalidate build/platform snapshots while preserving labels.
Fresh import causes no model use; reserved rows are excluded from preview/MCP proposal access and training.
Explicit selected-candidate acceptance with mocked inference uses reserved reviewed data.
Exact acceptance replay invokes no inference and creates no duplicate measured work-log entry.
Candidate threshold change cannot reuse consumed acceptance groups.
Live preview retains only normalized pixel exposure tokens, no frames/events.
MCP cannot edit reserved labels or initiate acceptance/approval.
limitations: Positive acceptance uses explicitly mocked inference on generated images; simulated data_origin=real is a software policy test, not accuracy or independent-scene evidence.
Independence is limited to declared project development/selection/training coverage; upstream pretraining overlap is unknown.
Image-only evaluation does not score event correctness, false alarms, temporal duration or deployment performance.
Rule/match/event-sink workflows remain local-trial-only under this recipe, so this gate does not authorize their automatic external delivery.
No existing user project, actual learned model, outgoing destination or packaged application was changed by these tests.
